name: cockpit
description: Above the prompt: the current step, context, 5-hour, weekly and cache. Opens to show the activity map; grows to hold a delete, show workers, and show what the work produced.

cacheMinutes.title: Prompt cache lifetime (minutes)
cacheMinutes.description: 60 if your sessions use the 1-hour prompt cache, 5 for the default cache.

handoffAt.title: Hand off at context %
handoffAt.description: From this context fill the context ring turns orange and a Hand off button appears. Leave empty to turn it off.

modalNames.title: Modal accounts
modalNames.description: Profile=name pairs, such as myprofile=A. The Modal chip reads docs/modal-spend.csv in the session folder and shows only the accounts named here.

modalCap.title: Modal monthly cap ($)
modalCap.description: The Modal chip turns orange at $20 and red within $2 of this cap.
